### Our Ways Before the Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-ways-lord
Passage: Proverbs 5:21
Points:
- Proverbs highlights God's omniscience and omnipresence, showing that every human action is recorded.
- The Lord's examination of our paths is active, deliberate, and continually evaluating our deeds and motives.
- While the adulterous sins in Proverbs 5 are often pursued in secret, nothing is hidden from God.
- For believers in Christ, God's watchful gaze offers assurance that unseen acts of faithful service will be rewarded.

### Look Heavenward
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-may-17-2013.html
Passage: Proverbs 5:21
Points:
- God has exact, comprehensive knowledge of every detail in our lives.
- Believers can still face sudden trials and hardships even when walking in God's will.
- Unsettling circumstances serve as God's sovereign way of testing and building our faithfulness.
- When life becomes perplexing, believers should run toward God rather than retreat from Him.

### A Puritan Wife
Author: Michael Haykin
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/puritan-wife
Passage: Proverbs 5:18-19
Points:
- Proverbs 5:18–19 urges married couples to delight in one another and remain captivated by each other's love.
- Richard and Margaret Baxter modeled how spousal devotion eases daily work and mutual burdens.
- Imperfect partners can build enduring unions through intentional appreciation rather than nitpicking faults.
- A strong Christian marriage is anchored in mutual alignment around Christ, the Church, and eternal hope.
